name: Receita Federal CNPJ open data
tier_rationale: Government body (A8): 'tiers: RFB, CVM, BCB, GLEIF and Wikimedia all trusted' (P361 cond 7); P238 provider tier trusted.

reliability.justification: Authoritative federal company register (CNPJ open data); a monthly snapshot, so companies opened after the last dump may be missing (P236 cond 4).

cnpj_open_data.title: RFB CNPJ open-data monthly dump on the WebDAV share (Empresas, Estabelecimentos, Socios and code tables)

terms.quote: Terms classes (definitions for every chair file and registry entry): 'open' = free use, internal business use included (public domain, CC0, CC BY, open government data, and permissive or copyleft licences whose obligations V3LUM meets by runtime download and attribution, A6)

cnpj_open_data.notes: Quote: binding A1 definition of 'open' (open government data); research C0512 terms 'Dados abertos RFB (public)' / 'Receita Federal open data (public by law)', C0743 'RFB open data (free reuse).' WebDAV share: PROPFIND https://arquivos.receitafederal.gov.br/public.php/webdav/ (Depth: 1), then GET {YYYY-MM}/{file}.zip (Empresas, Estabelecimentos, Socios and code tables; ';' separated, latin-1). Only the share token RFB itself publishes on its official open-data page; stop if RFB requires a login (P238 cond 2). Only through `v3lum data import-rfb`, never a scan: tens of GB, streamed, resumable Range downloads, refused when free space < 3x the download (P238 cond 1, cond 3). Used by rfb_cnpj_bulk and cnpj_name_resolver.

notes: Seeded once for batches p2-G10-2 and p2-G10-3 (P238, P361): one importer shared by both. ttl 0: multi-GB dumps never enter the HTTP cache (the importer stores them under ~/.v3lum/datasets and deletes superseded dumps, P238 cond 5); the importer sets its own per-request byte and time limits. Minimisation at import (rule 4): CPF digits in MEI/EI names stripped, partner CPFs stay RFB-masked and are never join keys (P238 cond 4). .br hosts default to Accept-Language pt-BR.
